drhp.business: Sahana Systems provides AI, ML, IoT, BI and blockchain-based technology services across defence tech, fintech, health tech, edtech and master system integration. In defence it has built AI-powered anti-drone and radar systems for the Indian Army and works on electronic warfare, information warfare and digital product engineering. In fintech it manages end-user computing for US banks, has built its own switch for financial institutions, builds ONDC switches and UPI/NPCI-stack systems, and is digitising Primary Agricultural Credit Societies in two Indian states. In healthcare it offers no-code AI platforms, hospital management information systems and EMR digitisation, and has served US healthcare customers since 2016. Government work makes up most of its business, including projects with the Ministries of Petroleum and Ports.
